Common.IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
Common.IdempotencyKeyHeader.description:
Client-chosen retry key, unique per intended create. A repeat with the same
key and body returns the first result; the same key with a different body
is refused with 409. Keys expire after 24 hours.

Common.IfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
Common.IfMatchHeader.description:
The `etag` of the version being changed. A request without it is refused
with 428 Precondition Required; a request whose tag is no longer current is
refused with 412 Precondition Failed.

Common.Attribute.description: Key-value attribute pair following OTel conventions

Common.AttributeBytesValue.description: Base64 bytes projected by qyl without colliding with an ordinary string attribute.

Common.AttributeDouble.description: An OTLP attribute double encoded as a JSON number when finite or a canonical named string when non-finite.

Common.AttributeInt64.description: An OTLP signed 64-bit attribute integer encoded without JavaScript precision loss.

Common.AttributeKeyValueListValue.description: Tagged recursive OTLP key-value-list, distinct from other object-shaped attribute variants.

Common.AttributeObjectValue.description: Object-shaped AttributeValue variants. The variant name is the wire `type` tag.

Common.CollectorKeyRole.description:
Collector API key roles. Every key sent in `x-otlp-api-key` carries one or
more roles: `ingest` accepts OTLP, `read` serves the query routes, `write`
creates and updates user resources, and `delete` deletes them. Roles are
independent, so a leaked ingest key can neither read, change nor delete
anything.

Common.Cursor.description:

must not be parsed or built by a client.

Common.ETag.description:

lookback_minutes.description: Minutes before `end_time` (or now) when `start_time` is omitted. Default 60; list_releases defaults to 10080 (7 days). Maximum 43200 (30 days).

Workbench.WorkbenchSessionId.description:
Opaque identifier for one authenticated local workbench session.

Deliberately not Qyl.Api.Contracts.Common.SessionId, and not joinable with it.
A workbench session is a loopback browser session owned by the local runner: it
begins at cookie bootstrap, ends at logout or expiry, and never leaves the
machine. A Common.SessionId is an OTel telemetry session observed in ingested
spans, owned by the instrumented application, with its own lifetime and its own
continuity chain. The two have no common issuer, so equal values would be
coincidence. Correlate a workbench execution to telemetry through
WorkbenchTelemetryCorrelation.traceIds, never by comparing session identifiers.
